0022600117.text: Both teams are 2-0 this season, with the 76ers 1st in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East, Detroit 1st in the Central and 2nd in the East, and each on a two-game winning streak. Philadelphia is currently listed as out Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), LeBron James (back), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), while Detroit is without Jalen Duren (hamstring, strain) and Ausar Thompson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, and in 2025-26 the 76ers lost 0-4, most recently 116-93 in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026.
